lines.t: (Soft, rhythmic acoustic fingerpicking with a warm, "woody" tone)
Down where the willow leans
In the tangled grey and the forest greens
I was carrying a heavy weight
Like a stone pulled from a garden gate
The world was loud and the sky was dim
I was standing right there on the rim
But I found You in the water (male: in the water)
I found You in the deep (male: in the deep)
Where the mercy started waking
What I used to try to keep
I didn't have to search the sky
Or wait for the well to run dry
I found it at the river's edge
(male: the river's edge)
The current knows my name
It doesn’t ask about the old-world shame
Just a steady pulse against the shore
I don’t have to keep the tally anymore
The sunlight filters through the pines
Changing all the architectural lines
Yeah, I found You in the water (male: in the water)
I found You in the deep (male: in the deep)
Where the mercy started waking
What I used to try to keep
I didn't have to search the sky
Or wait for the well to run dry
I found it at the river's edge
(male: the river's edge)
[Bridge - Female Lead, hushed and close-mic]
(Male: Soft, wordless "oohs" that follow the guitar melody)
The darkest hour is a quiet place
Till it’s washed away by a sudden grace
No more running, no more fear
Just the wild and the Spirit here
Just the wild...
At the river's edge...
Just the wild...
At the river's edge...
